program.label: Sinai Palimpsests Project
program.description: Imaged and studied as part of the Sinai Palimpsests Project (2011–2016), a collaboration between St. Catherine’s Monastery of the Sinai, the Early Manuscripts Electronic Library, and UCLA Library, funded by the Arcadia Fund and the Ahmanson Foundation. The project used multispectral imaging and scholarly analysis to recover and document erased and obscured texts in palimpsest manuscripts from the monastery’s collection.

note.value: Cataloging and imaging follows current sequence of folios as found in February 2014; alternate foliations are indicated for each folio
For the complete folios, there are different foliation systems in pencil, all incomplete and not corresponding to current sequence; the last two folios carry no foliation
The handwritten catalogers' notes in the cardboard manuscript wrapping yield no relevant information regarding foliation; the sleeves which contain the fragments are numbered 1 to 46
Burn marks; many folios badly eaten | All folios were pressed and flattened, some have white fibers attached
Previous catalogs dated this manuscript to the 9th-10th c. CE.
The cardboard wrapping contained an envelope of fragments of various sizes.
In February 2014, large fragments from the envelope were placed in acrylic sleeves (frags. 1-25); small fragments were first placed in paper sleeves, then in acrylic sleeves (26-46).
